proposal.summary: Record the documented GET /v1/organization/usage/decisions endpoint, admin API key and api.usage.read requirement, time/bucket/filter/group controls and request-not-question count semantics as a conditional Decisions feature. Preserve all prior exact model, typed-input, cache, lifecycle and Copilot authentication facts and their original provenance.

evidence.quote: Use GET /v1/organization/usage/decisions to retrieve your organization’s Decisions token usage and request counts. Authenticate with an admin API key and the api.usage.read permission. Choose a time range and bucket width, then filter or group the results by project, API key, or model. The num_model_requests field counts requests, not individual questions: a request with several questions counts once.
Send requests to POST /v1/decisions using gpt-6-luna , the only currently supported model.

reviewRequired: All model-fact changes require human review; no auto-merge or publication.
